coverage_assessment: Open-web first pass: 26 searches, 691 result headers; 10 candidates, 1 below-threshold exclusion, 1 pre-existing continuation and 20 gaps. Strongest coverage is Bogotá, Medellín, Cartagena, Bucaramanga, Arauca, Córdoba and Ibagué; Pacific/Amazonian, rural, other coastal and several sector areas remain weak. Search absence is not evidence of no event. The ledger records 11 actual body-read cards/results; independent terminal review approved effective S009/R011 use, so 10 of 11 are effective, with S043 preserved but quarantined. S009 request/read time remains unknown. S010 is reconciled; S012 remains search-only after CacheMiss/DNS failure before HTTP. Dataverse exposes CC0 metadata and a historical 2015 codebook, but latest official-file compatibility is unverified. No hemeroteca pass; not exhaustive.
